name: drawer-36
description: Admin users table where clicking a row opens a controlled drawer with that user's details.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Drawer, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/drawer" import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption, } from "@workspace/ui/components/native-select" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const users = [ { id: 1, name: "Ali Imam", email: "ali@designali.com", role: "Owner", lastSeen: "Online now", mfa: true, }, { id: 2, name: "Studio Designer", email: "design@designali.com", role: "Admin", lastSeen: "2h ago", mfa: true, }, { id: 3, name: "Studio Developer", email: "dev@designali.com", role: "Member", lastSeen: "3d ago", mfa: false, }, ] type User = (typeof users)[number] export default function UserRowDetailsDrawer() { const [user, setUser] = React.useState(null) return (
User Role {users.map((row) => ( setUser(row)} >

{row.name}

{row.email}

 {row.role} ))}
!open && setUser(null)} swipeDirection="right" > {user && ( <> {user.name .split(" ") .map((part) => part[0]) .join("")} {user.name} {user.email} Role Owner Admin Member
Last seen {user.lastSeen}
Two-factor {user.mfa ? "Enabled" : "Not set up"}
)}
) }
